the fabrication of colloids composed of pore-expanded nanoparticles.
the development of novel colloidal crystals composed with pore-expanded MSNs.
the preparation and characterization of colloidal crystals of pore-expanded MSN particles with a controllable size and pore size.

the pore size and the particle size of MSNs can be tuned independently, and the colloidal crystals composed thereof can be prepared by using the controlled growth method.
